name: protein kinase, DNA-activated, catalytic subunit
pathways: positive regulation of transcription by RNA polymerase II

function.text: PRKDC encodes DNA-dependent protein kinase catalytic subunit. Annotated molecular activities include protein kinase activity and DNA-dependent protein kinase activity. It participates in telomere maintenance and positive regulation of transcription by RNA polymerase II.

germline.text: Strong or definitive GenCC assertions link constitutional variants to severe combined immunodeficiency due to DNA-PKcs deficiency (autosomal recessive).

somatic.text: This gene is included in cancer-panel definitions, but a disease-specific somatic association has not been assigned from the alteration-context sources reviewed for this draft.

germline_associations.mechanism: Autosomal recessive; definitive GenCC assertion from ClinGen. Allele-specific mechanism requires review.
